output.explanation: Verified against checkout commit 8ca143700ca4d2c870f1101b8cd4601ab68abd41 without modifying files. The central diagram now follows App -> workspace page -> draft registry -> draft -> session -> controller, with mounted renderers and persistence adapters beside the state they consume. Two peripheral diagrams elaborate controller semantics/history and backend collaborators, including direct connections between those peripherals. Source checks clarified that the runtime revision registry is shared rather than history-owned; GenerationCanvasBridge is shared rather than owned by AgentChatService; renderer anchors remain local; and change acceptance checks live document/name baselines, not merely a live version number. Injected dependencies and calls are distinguished from owned state. Native pointer/camera frames remain local; completed gestures reach the semantic controller.

Mapping: browser workspace ownership
|

    |-- Client services (src/app/services.ts)
    |   |-- DefaultCanvasHistoryService -> shared across workspace sessions
    |   `-- WorkspaceStorage
    |       |-- RecordStorage: buffered record state / batches
    |       `-- Storage worker -> /api/mapping/workspace/records
    |-- MappingPocPage: service context provider
    |   `-- MappingWorkspacePage (src/features/mapping/MappingPage.tsx)
    |       |-- CanvasWorkspace: draft registry and session lifetimes
    |       |   |-- Controller index, subscriptions and dirty-scene index
    |       |   |-- CanvasDraft per document: metadata and saved baseline
    |       |   |   `-- CanvasSession
    |       |   |       |-- Read-only document / presentation / selection stores
    |       |   |       |-- Controls / geometry / status stores; dirty baseline
    |       |   |       |-- cursorCopy: pending pasted content
    |       |   |       `-- MappingDocumentController
    |       |   |           |-- Snapshot: document + canvas + version + geometry
    |       |   |           |-- Editing-context handle; optional editor driver
    |       |   |           |-- applyUpdate / select / commitDocument / canvasView
    |       |   |           |   `-- Validate, reconcile -> history; notify stores
    |       |   |           `-- New checkpoint -> session.onCommit -> onPersist
    |       |   `-- setDrafts(): create sessions; dispose removed/replaced ones
    |       |-- Transfer coordination: pending selection + transaction records
    |       |   `-- Copy/move and linked undo/redo -> BOTH document controllers
    |       |-- Mounted document surfaces (borrow each draft's session)
    |       |   `-- MappingEditorCanvas
    |       |       |-- tldraw Editor: live geometry, camera and native undo
    |       |       |-- MappingEditorRuntime: editor/controller adapter
    |       |       |   `-- settle() -> controller.commitEditorGesture()
    |       |       |-- CanvasRuntime: projected models and selection gestures
    |       |       |   |-- LocalAnchorStore: measured renderer-local anchors
    |       |       |   `-- NativeRoutingStore: connection geometry / worker

    |       |       `-- MappingPocSelectionCanvas: application overlay
    |       |           |-- SelectionLayer / Actions / Effects / CursorCopyOverlay

    |       |-- Explorer, submenu, FloatingPane / WindowPanel tool surfaces
    |       |   |-- SourceWindowPanel / SourceCodePane -> selected source evidence
    |       |   |-- ProjectionLayoutPanel -> commitProjectionLayout(expectedVersion)
    |       |   `-- Change previews / DiffTree / saved views / generated canvases
    |       |-- DiagramSearchService + symbol search -> focusBox / navigation
    |       |-- PromptComposerCoordinator
    |       |   |-- Drafts, references, exact retries and polling timers
    |       |   `-- DiagramEditClient -> agent service; revision receivers -> controller
    |       |-- useAgentCanvasBridge: register / poll / execute / reply / unregister

    `-- EvalsPage: alternative /evals surface -> evaluation services

Controller semantics and shared history (domain/)
|
|-- MappingDocumentController (mapping/workspace/mappingDocumentController.ts)
|   |-- ControllerSnapshot
|   |   |-- MappingGridDocument
|   |   |   |-- LineGridScene
|   |   |   |   |-- Root container tree: positioned diagram/container instances
|   |   |   |   `-- contents: versioned Diagram values referenced by instances
|   |   |   |       |-- Identity/revision + highlights + jumps
|   |   |   |       |-- DiagramContent: ASCII/hash; pinned asciiTree/asciiGraph parsing

|   |   `-- MappingCanvasState

|
|-- DefaultCanvasHistoryService (core/diagrams/canvasHistoryService.ts)
|   |-- WeakMap<CanvasEditingContext, CanvasHistory>
|   |   `-- CanvasHistory per editing handle (not one per document identity)
|   |       |-- CanvasHistoryRecord: head/baseline, past/future, checkpoints
|   |       |   |-- Composition + diagramBindings to immutable revisions
|   |       |   `-- Retained revisions, saved views and generation candidates
|   |       |-- DiagramRevisionEditor: resolve / merge against context bindings
|   |       `-- Checkpoint encoder and incremental change log
|   |-- openContext / append / navigate / forkContext / adopt / prepareTransfer

|
`-- Runtime revision registry (core/diagrams/internal/revisionRegistry.ts)
    |-- Immutable DiagramRevision records indexed by revision ID
    |-- diagramRevisionStore.ts: create / revise / import / retain API

Backend composition and external workspace collaborators
createBackend (src/server/app/bootstrap.ts): wires services, ports and stores
|
|-- MappingWorkspaceService: project-scoped loadRecords / applyBatch / import/export
|   `-- Injected MappingWorkspaceStore
|       `-- WorkspaceRecordStore: durable workspace records, separate from publication
|-- MappingDiagramService: initialize / save / publishCheckpoint / delete
|   `-- -> shared DiagramStore: project catalogs + DiagramPersistence / revisions
|-- ProjectSourceService: files / source / definitions
|   |-- Resolve DiagramSourceContext binding -> CorpusAccess reads
|   `-- -> optional ProjectLanguageService for definition lookup
|-- FileCompactionService
|   |-- Injected runtime + FileCompactionStore; owns active tasks
|   `-- Workflow validates compacted source -> CoreApplication / project catalog
|
|-- AgentDiagrammingSessionService
|   |-- Attachments, request receipts, execution runs and ChatCanvasBindings
|   |-- CanvasReadAliases; injected shared CanvasApiProjection
|   |-- Optional DiagramEditService + DiagramBatchService
|   |   `-- Generate/apply revision proposals -> CanvasSessionPort
|   |-- Validated tools -> shared GenerationCanvasBridge or ChangeSessionService
|   `-- Execution -> QuickJsAgentRuntime; context resolution -> AgentContextService
|-- AgentContextService -> shared AgentContextLibrary / stored source snapshots
|-- GenerationCanvasBridge (shared CanvasSessionPort, NOT owned by AgentChatService)
|   |-- Isolated generation contexts
|   |   |-- MappingDocumentController per context -> domain history
|   |   `-- Mutation receipts, serial queue and persistence callback
|   `-- Wrapped CanvasSessionBridge: dispatch / poll / reply -> browser bridge
|-- LiveCanvasService: availability/context -> bridge; selection updates -> clients
|-- AgentChatService
|   |-- Injected Codex connection, FileChatStore, ChatDiagramTools and MCP binding
|   |-- -> shared agent service / context library / GenerationCanvasBridge
|   `-- Isolated candidates use domain commands without changing browser selection
|-- SelectionService + LocalChatService
|   `-- Captured ASCII / selection / source evidence -> Pi or Codex runtime adapters
|
|-- ChangeSessionService
|   |-- Own history service and serialization queues; injected change-session store
|   |-- Stored baseline/proposed documents, pinned Git context, DiffTree, receipts
|   |-- Proposal operations -> headless MappingDocumentController (not live drafts)
|   `-- accept(): proposal version + live baseline check -> catalog.acceptCanvasChanges
|-- DiffSessionWorkflowService
|   |-- Injected runtime + run store; captured Git hunks and canvases
|   `-- -> agent service + ChangeSessionService proposals
|-- PushIntegrationService -> Git push source + DiffSessionWorkflowService
|
|-- CompareSessionService: pinned comparisons -> workspace + GeneratedCanvasCatalog
|-- ComparisonGenerationService: persisted comparison runs -> CompareSessionService
|-- EvalRunService: prepared inputs, generation cells, running tasks and results
|   |-- Assigned LayoutTemplateService + ReferenceGenerationService
|   |-- Assigned JudgementService + ExperimentService
|   `-- -> compare/workspace/context/prompt services; roll-up and result stores
|-- EvalPromptService -> EvalReferenceService
|-- GeneratedCanvasCatalog: reusable outputs; snapshot callback -> EvalRunService
`-- dispose(): stop tasks, bridges and optional language services
